mutants.description: allocation updates the counters but never marks the frame as owned
mutants.old: owners := fun i => if i = idx then .user else p.owners i
mutants.witness:
theorem witness_alloc_unaccounted : ¬ type_of% @pool_step_preserves_accounted := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h ({ totalFrames := 1, freeCount := 1, allocatedCount := 0, owners := fun _ => .free, generations := fun _ => 1 } : FramePool) (.allocUser 0) (by unfold FramePool.Accounted; decide)
  revert h0
  unfold FramePool.Accounted
  decide

def wxP0 : Pte := ⟨5, true, false, false, true, false⟩
def wxA : UserAspace :=
  { asid := 0, isKernelFrame := fun _ => false,
    entries := fun v => if v = 0 then some wxP0 else Option.none }
theorem witness_remap_wx : ¬ type_of% @aspace_step_preserves_wx := by
  intro h
  have hwx : wxA.WxSafe := by
    intro va pte he
    by_cases hv : va = 0
    · subst hv
      simp [wxA] at he
      subst he
      unfold Pte.WxAndPrivSafe
      decide
    · simp [wxA, hv] at he
  have h1 := h wxA (.remap 0 true true true false) hwx 0 ⟨5, true, true, true, true, false⟩ (by decide)
  revert h1
  unfold Pte.WxAndPrivSafe
  decide
